title: Enhancing TEM Sample Preparation Efficiency with an Extendable Nanomanipulator Tip for FIB SEM Systems
content: This study introduces a novel hardware modification that enables researchers to adjust the length of a nanomanipulator needle inside of the vacuum chamber of a dual-beam FIB-SEM without requiring system venting. This advancement improves throughput and reduces instrument downtime—critical factors for transmission electron microscope (TEM) sample preparation, particularly in semiconductor manufacturing, where high demand for TEM samples necessitates process efficiency. Conventionally, manipulator needles shorten with each sample preparation until reaching a mechanical limit, requiring system venting for replacement. Our innovation permits continuous needle extension via an external adjustment knob, significantly enhancing workflow efficiency.
